description:
Multi use trail, primarily used for mountain biking. Other activities include e-biking, trail running and hiking. Rated as a black, singletrack and can be ridden both directions. Often used as a connector trail. Dog friendly trail.

Distance 849.0 m | Ascent 61m | Descent -23m
directions: One Mile Lake area with many access points.(50.300110, -122.804760)
title: K2 Trail
